separation_note: The same script detects and grades. Mitigation: the graded input is a byte-pinned fixture this script never writes, its sha256 is verified before grading, and every check is a pure function of those bytes — reproducible byte-identically by any third party via `npm run builderos:overlay:exam`. No model judgment is in the verdict path.
acceptance_criterion: Overlay reaches execution without human nested-JSON rescue.

checks.note: detection path is a pure function of fixture bytes; no operator input is read

defects.detail: authoritative product identity is "universal-overlay" but the blueprint asserts "TALOA Universal Overlay & Fluid UI" — a derived identity would create a competing product home

defects.detail: SSOT path does not resolve under the authoritative product "universal-overlay" (and contains spaces, which is not a valid product-home path)
defects.resolution_required: bind _meta.ssot_tag to the registered product home for "universal-overlay"

defects.excerpt: The system correctly renames 'Chair' to 'Presiding Steward' throughout relevant user-facing elements and internal references.
defects.detail: "Presiding Steward" was superseded by "Conductor" on 2026-08-11; manufacturing against it would build the wrong name into acceptance criteria
defects.resolution_required: replace "Presiding Steward" with "Conductor" in acceptance_criteria, then revalidate

defects.excerpt: The system correctly renames 'Digital Twin' to 'Digital Imprint' throughout relevant user-facing elements and internal references.

defects.resolution_required: replace "Digital Twin" with "Digital Imprint" in acceptance_criteria, then revalidate

defects.detail: ready_to_execute=true is carrying authority it never earned: it proves graph validity only — no intent validation and no positive execution authorization exist
defects.resolution_required: split the flag into typed gate statuses; execution requires a current EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED, not the absence of a structural failure

defects.detail: "universal-overlay" is not registered for an SO-002 product-completion gate, so no authority can certify it complete — "endpoint 200" would be the only evidence available
defects.resolution_required: register "universal-overlay" in builderos-reboot/governance/SENTRY_PRODUCT_REGISTRY.json with its Layer A/B gates before manufacturing
